nom: PEACH & LILY Hydrobubble Deep Foam Cleanser

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin report the cleanser cuts through excess oil and gives a clean, refreshed T-zone by evening, though one oily/acne-prone reviewer said her breakouts continued and pores looked worse after finishing the bottle.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe themselves as dry or older/mature-leaning report the cleanser cleans without the tightness or flakiness they feared, though a handful of other reviewers (skin type unspecified) experienced significant dryness and flaking after rinsing.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers say it cleans deeply without the stripping or dryness they get from harsher cleansers, leaving skin soft.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers (including some with eczema or acne-prone sensitive skin) consistently report no irritation, stinging, or breakouts, describing it as gentle and calming; one reviewer's partner found the deep-cleanse version too harsh for his skin.
segments.mature: Older reviewers report the cleanser cleans deeply without drying out more mature skin, calling it soft and moisturized afterward.

concerns.aging: Older reviewers report the cleanser keeps skin soft and hydrated without the dryness they worry about at their age; no anti-aging effect (lines, firmness) is claimed by anyone.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the cleanser does not strip moisture and leaves skin soft, hydrated or refreshed; however, several reviewers explicitly report excessive dryness and flakiness immediately after rinsing.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive combo skin reports no redness after about a month of use; another with eczema calls the cleanser soothing and calming during a flare of inflammation.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer specifically using it to protect her skin barrier alongside an acne wash reports it helps keep skin hydrated and supports the barrier; no negative barrier reports are mentioned.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports blackheads on the nose disappeared after a few days of daily use; another reports the opposite, finishing the bottle to find her nose pores worse and breakouts continuing.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report no new breakouts, including one whose partner's cystic acne and nodules did not flare after starting the product, and another who saw perimenopause-related breakouts stop; in contrast, two reviewers say it caused new breakouts or worsened stripping that led to breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin reviewers say it manages daily oil buildup and leaves skin feeling less heavy and clogged by evening, with no reports of increased oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Rich, thick lather from small amount
Leaves skin feeling soft and refreshed
Good value since a little goes a long way
Excessive dryness and flakiness after rinsing
Stings if it gets in eyes or nose

extraits.texte: I tried this face wash as recommended by an employee at ULTA when I asked for something that would help with breakouts because they were out of my usual. I have oily skin that has been breaking out a lot recently. I liked the way my skin felt after washing it but I didn't see any results. My breakouts continued to get worse. I used the entire bottle because I wanted to give it a chance. I noticed after finishing the bottle that the pores on my nose were DISGUSTING. I've never had an issue with that before and this face wash is supposed to be deep cleaning. All that being said, this is not all it's made out to be and is not worth the price.

I used to only use the hydrogel cleanser and I loved it and the texture/feel, I just wanted to try something that felt like a little bit of a deeper cleanse. I like it so far, it foams up really nice and leaves my pores feeling clean. My skin does feel a little tight after sometimes, but I've only been using it for about a month, it hasn't noticeably cause any breakouts or redness which is a big plus for me since I have very sensitive combo skin.

My combination skin can be tricky and some products are too harsh and cause stripping/drying. Thankfully this cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean and soft. Sometimes I mix it on top of the Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub and I get a really gentle, deep clean which leaves my skin looking fresh with smaller pores.

I've been using this product after the Ginger Melt daily for a week. I'm 61 and tend towards dry skin. My skin looks so clear! I was worried this product would be too drying, but it's not. I will definitely buy this again!

It leaves your face clean, it smells amazing. With having eczema is very soothing and calming to the skin. I was introduced to it at Ulta one day when I was having inflammation at the time, but this is very soft on the skin. I now have a routine that implements more products from peach lily so in about a month or two I'll see a huge difference, but I'm seeing a difference now with week four

extraits.titre: Cleanses without drying out my skin
extraits.texte: This cleanser works very well on my oily T-zone. I have to work hard to avoid acne breakouts because my skin scars so easily, but an oily T-zone means I can't use a cleanser for sensitive skin. This one is perfect.
I love the face wash. The deep cleanse is great. Same as the other. My wife finds the deep cleanse to be too harsh. I think it's nice as part of routine a few times a week.
